title: Step 15 — find the settled leg by FX trade id
description: Search returns the locks visible to the caller, filtered to those where its own institution is a counterparty. The initiator's leg is now HTLC_STATE_SETTLED and the secret is public.
notes: Gateway: Banco de San Jose commercial-bank gateway. total is the length of locks, not a page count — there is no pagination. Only ONE lock comes back: the responder's leg lives on the spoke-pen orchestrator and is not indexed here. The agreement_id query parameter takes an FX trade_id despite its name. Its state parameter accepts the bare vocabulary (LOCKED|SETTLED|REFUNDED) while the records it returns use the prefixed one — reproduced as published, not normalised. A ROLE_SUPERVISOR caller gets a network-wide on-chain read instead, and a failure there answers 502 'on-chain scan failed: ...'.
